name: ELRA / ELDA Catalogue
aliases: Evaluations and Language resources Distribution Agency

operator_role.note: ELDA signs the user licence in its own name as DISTRIBUTOR under a distribution licence from the owner; the owner is not a party.

economics_model.note: Third-party providers receive 'payment, royalties or other compensation' (split not published); ELRA also sells resources it produced.

who_pays_fee.note: Buyer pays a list price; how ELRA's share is taken from provider proceeds is not published.

supply_models.note: Whether ELDA production-service outputs are relisted (commissioned_nonexclusive) is not published.

custody_model.note: Provider supplies the resource to ELRA; ELDA delivers a copy by download to the buyer's named site.

transaction_mode.note: Fixed list prices with a cart/order form, but every sale closes with an emailed licence signed by hand and an invoice; buyers are also invited to email ELDA.

public_prices.note: All three listings opened showed full price grids; not checked across the whole catalogue.

exclusivity_offered.note: ELRA's user contracts grant non-exclusive rights; no exclusive option was found on any page read.

public_listing.note: Anonymous visitor sees full descriptions and price grids.

buyer_vetting.note: Order form collects institution, VAT number and membership; research licence requires bona fide research; no check procedure published.

sample_mechanics.note: Providers send ELRA a sample; the three listings opened showed no buyer sample. Not checked catalogue-wide.

versioning.note: Listings show 'Version: 1.0' and suffixed IDs (S0490_01), but no policy on new versions for past buyers.

human_subject_consent_docs.note: Neither licence template nor provider forms nor the listing of a corpus of recorded patients mention consent.

contributor_pay_model.note: ELRA pays providers (organisations); how recorded speakers or creators were paid is not stated.

erasure_after_sale.note: Licence is perpetual with no termination, deletion or takedown clause.

quality_evidence.note: ELRA states resources are validated before distribution; providers also self-report validation. Licences disclaim quality.

Q1.answer: Buyers are academic and commercial HLT organisations (members in telecoms, marketing, multilingual business) licensing whole corpora per site; ELRA's catalogue includes audiovisual corpora. No volume data by buyer type was citable.

Q2.answer: ELRA pitches wider distribution and a non-profit clearing house with standard licences and IPR clearance; no provider-side outcome data found.

Q3.answer: Third-party providers (e.g. 67 Datatang speech resources) grant ELRA a distribution licence for payment, royalties or other compensation; ELRA also lists resources it produced.

Q5.answer: ELDA is licensor of record as DISTRIBUTOR under distribution rights from the rightful holder; ELDA and owners disclaim all warranties and neither side indemnifies.

Q6.answer: The provider supplies the data to ELRA and ELDA delivers a copy, preferably by download, after the signed licence is received.

Q7.answer: Consent is not addressed: licence templates, provider forms and a listing of recorded patients are silent on consent of people recorded.

Q8.answer: Tiered standard licences (research End-User, Evaluation, commercial VAR), non-exclusive, perpetual, site-bound, with bans on sharing language models; no audit or deletion clauses.

Q9.answer: Fixed public prices by member status, user nature and licence; order form or cart, then a hand-signed licence and invoice paid by wire, cheque or card. Providers get royalties or other compensation.

Q10.answer: A listing is a resource with ELRA ID, ISLRN, version and availability date; the licence names it in Exhibit A and is perpetual. No stated policy for new versions or withdrawals.

Q11.answer: ELRA says resources are validated before distribution and providers submit samples and validation info; listings opened showed no buyer samples, and the licence disclaims quality.

Q12.answer: The off-the-shelf side is the ELRA Catalogue (Distribution); the bespoke side is ELRA/ELDA 'production services'.

unknowns.note: Only 'payment, royalties or other compensation' is stated; no split or fee.
Order form asks institution, VAT, membership; licence signed by authorised person; no published check.
Three listings opened had no sample link; catalogue-wide search hit HTTP 429.
Version field shown on listings; no policy text found.
Nothing on how speakers/participants were paid.
No statement on relisting data produced for commissioning clients.
The provider-side distribution agreement template is not linked from any page read.
Web search was unavailable in this run; no independent press or academic source on ELRA's business was located by navigation.
The activity-reports page lists reports only up to 2022; no 2023-2025 figures found.

conflicts.resolution: Both pages are live: the catalogue says return the order form by email, elra.info (and its FAQ) says by fax. The catalogue page is likely the current practice.
